Текст вопроса

3. Fill in the gaps with the correct Personal pronoun. Replace the words in brackets with suitable personal pronoun.

Example: (This book) is not suitable for young children. - It

1. (Mary) likes her friends. -
2. (My sister and I) don't like to walk our dogs. -
3. (The boy) overslept this morning and didn't have time to have breakfast. -
4. (Dad and Mom) went to see their friends. -
5. (Your brother and you) spend too much time playing football. -
6. (You and I) are good friends, aren't ...? -
7. (Mrs. Smith) went home because her husband was tired. -
8. (This cat) is very dirty. -
9. Yesterday (my sister and I) made a present to our mother. -
10. (The salesmen) gave him two boxes. -

5. Fill in the gaps with the correct Objective pronoun.

Example: Parents advised him (he) to go to the library.

 

1. It’s easy for (I) to learn verses.
2. It took (we) two hours to get there. 
3. We’re looking for (you). 
4. I invited (they) to my birthday party. 
5. Were (you) informed of the accident? 
6. Don’t talk about (he) in such words! 
7. They were glad to see (we) at the station. 
8. He’s always playing jokes on (I). 
9. Did you help (she)? 
10. He spent a lot of time with (they).
